To establish the pact, spend: this city {变量2}; Lakeside City 120 wood, 24 tools; North Shore 1200 wood, 240 tools. Afterward, every 60 seconds the local liaison office consumes {变量3}, deducted directly from the departure district's public warehouse and recorded separately. {分支4}

Trade Access: Trade by water with Lakeside and North Shore only; each ship can carry up to 80 items. North Shore maintains its own facilities, and its population is not included in Shared Services coverage.

Shared Services: Choose “Civilian Repairs” to supply 320 medicine and 80 iron per ship, or “Industrial Supplies” to supply 320 iron and 80 medicine per ship. With Industrial Supplies, local wood and tool requirements for maintenance each period are doubled.
